find_feed.description: Check whether Open RSS has a feed for a website, and get its address to paste into a reader app - along with the website's name, icon, when it last published, and anything Open RSS wants you to know about it, such as that the website already publishes a feed of its own. This never stops a run: a website with no feed yet comes back as an answer, not an error, so a workflow can branch on it. And asking is not wasted - Open RSS adds a website it has no feed for to its backlog to build one.

description: Get the newest posts from any website, even one that publishes no feed of its own. Type the address the way you'd type it in a browser - a news site, a blog, a YouTube channel, a subreddit, a Bluesky account, a GitHub project's releases - and Open RSS finds the feed. Read one website or merge several into a single digest, keep only what's new since the last run, and get every post the same way: headline, link, author, date, a plain-text summary and a picture. Open RSS is a nonprofit and the service is free, with no account and no API key.
